author: National Geographic
description:
Away from the towns and beaches, Grenada offers a deep well of restorative traditions for visitors seeking a relaxing escape. Rooted in the Grenadian "river lime"—a hangout by the water to help unwind and connect with loved ones in nature—the Caribbean island's verdant forests and waterfalls provide a stunning backdrop.

author: National Geographic
description:
Join world-renowned magician, mentalist, and endurance artist David Blaine on an extraordinary global journey across South Africa, Japan, and India in this MEGA episode compilation of David Blaine: Do Not Attempt from National Geographic.
 
Watch as Blaine seeks out master illusionists, street performers, and spiritual practitioners to uncover the extreme mental and physical discipline behind the world's most incredible magic. Follow David as he immerses himself in other cultures, absorbs ancient techniques, and pushes the limits of human performance.

South Africa - 00:00 
In South Africa, a country once shaped by apartheid, David discovers how magic is breaking down barriers and reshaping perceptions.

Japan - 36:46
In Japan, David explores the concept of mastery by meeting with people who spend a lifetime refining a single skill.

India - 1:10:32
David Blaine journeys to India, the birthplace of much of magic, to explore belief and performance through the lens of magic.
